scope: Redacted Obsidian installation and Volt runtime verification summary.

plugins.name: QuickAdd
plugins.configuration: Inbox task capture (one value input) and New task note commands

rawEvidenceStorage.note: This committed summary is shareable. Raw runtime logs and the screenshot remain local only.

successCriteria.scenario: Register the Volt vault, open bookmarked Home, and preserve the active Home file after restart.
successCriteria.invocation: obsidian vault=Volt open path='90-System/Home.md'; restart Obsidian; query active file
successCriteria.binaryObservable: Home opened and the active path was 90-System/Home.md after restart.

successCriteria.scenario: Create a note from the core Task template and query the Doing and Blocked Bases views after changing the sample task.
successCriteria.invocation: obsidian vault=Volt create ... template=Task; property:set; base:query
successCriteria.binaryObservable: The template created a dated, titled note; each changed state returned the sample once, and restored todo/false returned empty views.

successCriteria.scenario: Route an attachment and rename a linked note through the app runtime.
successCriteria.invocation: obsidian vault=Volt quickadd:save-clipboard-image; obsidian vault=Volt move
successCriteria.binaryObservable: The attachment path was under 99-Attachments and the referring link changed to the renamed target.

successCriteria.scenario: Run both initial community-plugin workflows and verify their settings survive restart.
successCriteria.invocation: obsidian vault=Volt quickadd:run choice='Inbox task capture' verify; obsidian vault=Volt quickadd:run choice='New task note' verify; restart Obsidian
successCriteria.binaryObservable: Both commands returned ok:true, verified:true, effect:created; Tasks listed the #task item; Tasks 8.4.0, QuickAdd 2.25.0, the #task filter, and both choices remained enabled after restart.

successCriteria.scenario: Restore the pre-install vault snapshot to a separate temporary directory.
successCriteria.invocation: ditto -x <snapshot> <temporary-restore-dir>; compare paths and file SHA-256 values
successCriteria.binaryObservable: Restore and all recorded comparisons passed; the hidden .obsidian directory was present.

successCriteria.scenario: Remove runtime test notes and attachments after verification.
successCriteria.invocation: Obsidian runtime delete followed by vault test-resource scan
successCriteria.binaryObservable: The scan reported no current test resources remaining in the vault.

limitations: The verified snapshot is on the same disk and is not an independent backup.
Computer Use accessibility calls did not return an AX snapshot; official Obsidian CLI runtime and an app screenshot verified the app state.
futureWork: Review actual project use, categories, WIP, and optional plugins after one week.
Choose and test one sync method only if another device requires access.
